name: @pipeworx/mcp-dictionary

tools.name: define_word
tools.description: Look up a word's definition, pronunciation, part of speech, and usage examples. Returns meaning, phonetic spelling, and example sentences.

tools.name: get_synonyms
tools.description: Find synonyms and antonyms for any word. Returns similar words and opposites, useful for writing and paraphrasing.

word.description: The word to find synonyms/antonyms for

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dictionary forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dictionary pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
